top_signals.title: Ukraine’s Anti-Graft Agencies Search Central Bank Building
top_signals.summary: Ukraine’s National Anti-Corruption Bureau and Special Anti-Corruption Prosecutor’s Office searched the premises of the country’s central bank and an employee’s residence, they said in a Telegram statement.

top_signals.title: French supermarket giant's shares plunge 14% after warning ‘unprecedented’ unrest will hit business
top_signals.summary: Carrefour cut its full-year 2026 financial forecasts, citing worsening social unrest and security conditions in France, weighing on consumer spending.

top_signals.title: Nickel Rallies Past $16,000 on Prospect of Indonesia Output Cuts
top_signals.summary: Nickel rose for a fourth day as the prospect of coordinated output cuts by Chinese producers in Indonesia raised expectations of tighter supply.
